claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Cirazoline is an alpha1-adrenergic/imidazoline ligand with no DNA-damaging or antimitotic activity; at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is expected to produce little or no cytotoxicity, with any antiproliferative effect being weak and non-selective rather than a class-specific killing pattern.
